messages:
sam: Heads-up — draft release notes for the 08:00 PT deploy are in the doc. Can everyone scan for consumer-facing lines and reply with pin / no-pin? Planning canary then 30% then 100% if green. TL;DR: runtime optimizations + canary rollback guard.

sam: Release notes snippet:
```
- Improved request batching: ~15% cost reduction for small sequences
- Fix: KV cache eviction bug causing occasional memory spikes (dedicated customers affected)
- Ops: new canary rollout with automated fallback to v1.4.2
```

maya: Quick nit — change "memory growth" -> "memory spike" and add "(dedicated customers)". I can PR that now.

liam: Deploybot config question — can we set `--stagger=5m` and `--slo-fallback=95%`? If SLO drops below 95% for 10m, auto rollback.

liam: proposed command:
```
/deploy canary v1.5.0 --stagger=5m --threshold-rolling=10m --slo-fallback=95%
```

deploybot: Deploy scheduled by liam: canary v1.5.0 at 2026-03-22T08:00:00Z. Stagger 5m. Auto-rollback enabled at SLO <95% for 10m. Ping: @oncall.

dena: L10n note — translations will land by EOD but internal announce should be English-only for the immediate blast. I'll add a follow-up note for localized comms.

rana: Please pin the version in the internal announce: "Serving runtime v1.5.0 (pinned)". Also need clarity on rollback owner — oncall or liam?

sam: Rollback owner plan: oncall owns first 30m of canary, platform (liam/team) takes over if we need to roll forward/rollback cluster-wide. I'll add that to the runbook. Suggested internal copy (short):

"Internal: Rolling out serving runtime v1.5.0 (canary -> 100%). Improvements: request batching, KV cache fix. Canary monitors latency & errors; auto-rollback if SLO <95% for 10m. Owners: Oncall -> Platform. Do not contact customers unless rollback occurs"

maya: LGTM. I'll PR the copy and tag @comm for internal blast.

liam: I'll kick the canary per the command above once copy is pinned. @deploybot make sure deploy traces go to datadog/trace-service.

deploybot: Tracing integration confirmed: datadog.trace.service set for this rollout.

sam: Thanks — if no objections by 07:30 PT, we'll pin and proceed. :thumbsup:
